package.description: Re-assign the keys of your keyboard, mouse or desktop set individually with the new CHERRY KEYS software.

en-US.description: Re-assign the keys of your keyboard, mouse or desktop set individually with the new CHERRY KEYS software.
en-US.longDescription: CHERRY KEYS is the intuitive solution for keyboards and mice. CHERRY KEYS works with almost all keyboards and mice – regardless of manufacturer. However, due to the special keys that are often specific to certain keyboards, it works best with original CHERRY products. The software runs in the background and modifies the incoming signals from the input devices according to your wishes.
en-US.name: CHERRY KEYS

zh-CN.description: 通过全新的 CHERRY KEYS 软件对键盘、鼠标或键鼠套装的按键单独重新分配。
zh-CN.longDescription: CHERRY KEYS 是一款直观的键盘与鼠标解决方案。无论是哪个制造商，CHERRY KEYS 能够用于几乎所有键盘和鼠标。但由于一些键盘通常具有特殊按键，因此它与 CHERRY 产品配合使用效果最好。该软件在后台运行，并根据您的意愿修改来自输入设备的传入信号。
